summary: V498 lets a coldkey hold gamma outside a deposit and send it to other coldkeys. A mint with no hotkey credits the signer's gamma balance on the subnet. New calls deposit_gamma and withdraw_gamma move gamma between a balance and a deposit, and transfer_gamma sends an exact amount from a balance or deposit to another coldkey's balance or deposit. Another coldkey can open a deposit for a coldkey only while it holds fewer than 32 across subnets and has no coldkey swap underway. mint_gamma and mint_gamma_with_stake take an optional hotkey and move from call indices 166 and 167 to 178 and 179. The old indices are retired, so update the Python SDK before minting. The release adds the GammaBalances storage item and moves GammaRuntimeApi to version 3 with get_gamma_balances. It has no storage migrations. Spec version 498 with transaction version 2 needs a metadata refresh. Regenerate and review pending root parameter proposals before approving.
